component.selection: All cases except exact_lookup, direct_read, no_retrieval; 46 known dev queries, including 3 undefined evidence denominators.
component.retrieval: Qdrant exact=True; freeze each BM25/semantic top-40 ranking once, derive nested prefixes. This isolates depth from ANN candidate instability; not an ANN latency comparison.
component.primary_metric: equal-family mean draft evidence coverage in returned top-10 chunks
component.diagnostics: Coverage before fusion truncation, in the fixed 20-candidate pool, and top-10; facet losses and qrel assessment coverage. No final-answer quality inference.

stopping.selection: Known dev diagnostics: evidence discovery, exploration, bridge family, direct read, absent/partial/ambiguous evidence, no retrieval. Not random or representative. Selected before this run.
stopping.order: Trial 0 forward case order, trial 1 reverse; alternate first arm by original case position plus trial (each case starts with the opposite arm on its second trial). Independent fresh conversations, serial inference, temperature 0; no added seed or retries.
stopping.quality_gate: Needs independent reviewed grounded success on held-out families. Unknown semantics cannot pass the noninferiority gate; normal final and coverage are diagnostics only.
stopping.time_policy: Cooperative loop deadline, no cancellation of in-flight requests. Uncontrolled load/cache; no production latency claim.

statistics.aggregation: trial mean, then case mean within family, then equal family weights
statistics.secondary_intervals: Exploratory, unadjusted; no multiplicity-controlled superiority claim.

decision_policy: Continue only as a dev candidate if the preregistered effect is observed without an adverse diagnostic; reject a measured ineffective change for this round; otherwise evidence_insufficient. Production adoption additionally requires reviewed independent validation/test and cost evidence.
